title: Create src/lib/history.ts — iteration history writer
description: Create a module that saves each loop iteration's raw AI output to a file. Strips ANSI color codes before saving to keep history files human-readable.
acceptanceCriteria: saveIteration(agentDir, sessionId, iteration, rawOutput) is exported
ANSI escape codes are stripped from rawOutput before writing
History directory is created if it doesn't exist

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra, path. Import stripAnsi from 'strip-ansi'.

export async function saveIteration(agentDir: string, sessionId: string, iteration: number, rawOutput: string): Promise<void> { const historyDir = path.join(agentDir, 'history'); await fs.ensureDir(historyDir); const filename = `ITERATION-${sessionId}-${iteration}.txt`; const clean = stripAnsi(rawOutput); await fs.writeFile(path.join(historyDir, filename), clean, 'utf-8') }

technicalNotes: strip-ansi is a pure ESM package — import it as a default import: `import stripAnsi from 'strip-ansi'`
The session ID is generated once per loop session (using Date.now().toString()) and used for all iterations in that session
